title: opencode adapter
description: Managed block in ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md (core rules inline, router just in time) and five subagents (mode: subagent, inherit the calling model).
postInstall: opencode: the global AGENTS.md now exists, so opencode stops falling back to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (no double rules). Skills are read from ~/.agents/skills; if Claude Code is also installed the same skills exist in ~/.claude/skills too, and opencode's docs only say names must be unique across locations. To avoid duplicates, add to your shell profile: export OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE_SKILLS=1 (this also hides project .claude/skills). Subagents inherit the calling model; add model: provider/id to ~/.config/opencode/agents/*.md to route roles.
